data.title: Strategy reports wider-than-expected Q2 loss amid Bitcoin volatility
data.description: Strategy (NASDAQ:MSTR) shares fell 7% in pre-market trading after the company reported a wider-than-expected second quarter loss, largely driven by unrealized losses on its Bitcoin holdings. The company reported a net loss of $8.22 billion, or $24.45 per diluted share, for the three months...
